facts.fact: Adwave's guide says mobile CPMs for geofenced ads typically run $8 to $25 per thousand impressions, higher than run-of-network mobile ads.
facts.quote: Mobile CPMs (cost per thousand impressions) for geofenced ads typically run $8 to $25, higher than run-of-network mobile ads but with far greater relevance.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide says display geofencing is less expensive than mobile or CTV, with CPMs of $3 to $10.
facts.quote: Less expensive than mobile or CTV ($3 to $10 CPMs)

facts.fact: Adwave's guide says mobile geofencing offers very high precision (100m+) with a minimum budget of $500-1,000 per month.
facts.quote: offering very high precision (100m+) with a minimum budget of $500-1,000/month

facts.fact: Adwave's guide says CTV/streaming geofencing starts at $50+ with moderate zip code precision.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide says display advertising geofencing has a minimum of $200+.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide says social media geofencing starts around $100+ with moderate precision.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide states that most local businesses find 60 to 80 percent of customers come from a concentrated area.
facts.quote: Most local businesses find that 60 to 80 percent of customers come from a concentrated area.

facts.fact: Adwave's guide states that current geofencing platforms can target areas as small as a single building or as precise as a 100-meter radius.
